name: Training to the Speech and Hearing Impaired (Male)
department: Welfare of Differently Abled Persons Department
benefit: Vocational training and monthly stipend provided.
eligibility_rules: Male individuals with certified speech and hearing disability.
how_to_apply: Apply through government training institute for the disabled.
